changes.text: New 7-level funnel: Company survivability, Business quality, Business valuation, Management evaluation, Momentum analysis, Discovery stage, Future outlook. Every level has 5 colour-coded tiers and a rubric of checks

Rule-built verdict for every stock (Prime candidate, Early story, Undervalued quality, Momentum play, Quality priced in, Value watch, Watchlist) with a one-paragraph statement made from the checks, no AI text
Stock screen: Summary plus one swipeable tab per level. Summary has the chart, funnel ratings, analyst target (only when one exists), 8 key ratios, standouts and the trade setup

Valuation by business type: banks and NBFCs on P/B vs ROE, cyclicals on mid-cycle EBITDA, loss-makers on EV/sales, others on P/E or EV/EBITDA, against own history, peers and the growth the price implies

Event watch on researched stocks: every exchange announcement is stored and typed (red: default, insolvency, auditor exit, raid, regulatory action, fraud, downgrade, pledge invoked, CFO/CEO/MD exit; green: orders, capacity, approvals, upgrades, corporate actions). New red or green filings, due must-go-right / kill-switch dates and price shocks send the stock back to Claude for a re-check. Shown under Outlook > Announcements; red filings in the last 45 days also show on Summary
Entry setups: Breakout, Pullback or Base, with stop, add-above level, size for 1% risk and reward/risk to the analyst target. Flags when the entry is above the target
Home: wave funnel from Listed to Outlook with counts, then verdict sections with 7-level colour bars on each card

Money movement: market mood index (0-100, fear to greed) from India VIX, Nifty vs 200-day, breadth, 52-week highs/lows and advance/decline, plus the rotation map, money flowing in and out, and top picks in rising industries
Screener: filter by minimum tier on any level, discovery stage, setup, market cap, industry; show removed stocks with the level and reason; save filters
Scan button shows its state: Request deep scan, Request full scan, Refresh scan, Scan queued, or scanned recently
Settings: what's new, updates, checkpoint calendar with verdict changes, everything you sent from this phone, data sources
Old exclusion rules (thin margin, penny, illiquid, already ran, broken trend) no longer remove stocks; only the funnel levels do, and missing data never removes
Home has two modes: Top-down (sector and industry rotation map, best value stock in each rising industry) and Bottom-up
Bottom-up short term: trend turning up plus analyst consensus 20%+ above price, with broker count and freshness
Long-term sections: Undiscovered value, Beaten-up value, GARP, Multibagger potential, Hidden value
Stock Summary tab: scorecard, hidden-value metrics, analyst consensus (only when it exists), Bull/Base/Bear for scanned stocks
Every financial number is computed from company filings on NSE; tap any value to see its formula, inputs and the filing. A dash means it could not be computed
Feedback and deep-scan requests are sent from inside the app
No market-cap upper limit; trade bands no longer show a computed target
Undervalued lens ranks by overall score and skips P/E below 5 (one-offs and distressed stocks)
Timeline dates show as month and year (e.g. May '26)
Results checkpoints show the announced board-meeting source instead of the SEBI deadline
Update popup lists only changes since your installed version
First release: Home lenses, Discover, stock page with entry and exit bands
Promises vs actuals timeline with verified source quotes
Upcoming checkpoints, memory of dropped stocks, excluded lookup
Feedback button on every screen and in-app update check
